decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records J_BAT on a short edge with the battery alongside the PCB; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the applicable USB-C, display-connector, and antenna constraints, while J_BAT placement is owned by the separate battery-connector Requirement.
The source establishes connector and battery constraints for the integrated-board enclosure arrangement and does not modify the existing modular main-board layout rules.
Physical battery placement alongside the PCB does not change the AXP2101 electrical power-path topology or charging behavior.
The source does not change the modular sensor board's mounting, connector-access, or interboard-alignment requirements.
The source concerns integrated-board connector placement and does not necessarily revise the modular power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector-access state.
Battery and connector positioning does not alter the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement.
The source does not change the panel-mounted button, its connector, its board assignment, or its PWRON control behavior.
The enclosure and battery arrangement does not affect sensor logic voltage compatibility or the decision to omit on-board level shifting.
The source does not alter the SPS30 SEL-to-ground connection or its required I2C operating mode.
The battery's mechanical relationship to the integrated PCB does not change the separate LED board's count, part selection, package, or supply rule.
The source does not change the sensor-module connector inventory, pinouts, connector count, or sensor supply interfaces.
